name: XP Trade Manager
summary: XP Trade Manager is a trade management utility EA that does not open trades itself. It automatically applies Stop Loss, Take Profit, Break Even, and Trailing Stop management to existing positions and pending orders, with an optional Stealth Mode that hides SL/TP levels from the broker using chart objects instead of server-side orders.
summary_zh: XP Trade Manager是一个交易管理工具型EA，本身不开仓。它自动为已有持仓和挂单设置止损、止盈、保本和移动止损管理，并提供隐身模式，通过图表对象而非服务器端订单来隐藏止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 此EA不是策略型交易程序，而是一个仓位管理工具。它不会根据任何技术指标或信号自动开仓，仅对已存在的持仓和挂单进行管理。入场条件方面，完全依赖用户或其他EA手动开仓后，该EA才会介入管理。出场管理包括三个核心功能：首先是自动设置止损和止盈水平，基于用户输入的点数参数计算；其次是保本功能，当浮盈达到BEActivation点数时，将止损移至开仓价加BELevel点数的位置；最后是移动止损功能，当价格朝有利方向移动超过TSStart点数后，按TSStep步进和TSDistance距离动态追踪止损。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及加仓或减仓逻辑，仅修改已有仓位的止损止盈水平。资金管理方面，没有任何基于账户余额或风险比例的动态仓位计算。隐身模式下，止损止盈信息存储在图表对象中而非发送至服务器，避免经纪商看到这些水平，但此模式下EA必须持续运行才能执行止损止盈。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a strategy-based trading program but rather a position management utility. It does not open trades based on any technical indicators or signals; it only manages existing positions and pending orders. For entry conditions, it entirely relies on the user or other EAs to open positions manually before this EA intervenes. Exit management includes three core functions: first, automatically setting Stop Loss and Take Profit levels calculated from user-input pip parameters; second, a Break Even feature that moves the stop loss to the entry price plus BELevel pips when floating profit reaches BEActivation pips; third, a Trailing Stop feature that dynamically trails the stop loss by TSStep increments at TSDistance distance once price moves favorably beyond TSStart pips. For position sizing, this EA does not involve any lot-increasing or lot-decreasing logic—it only modifies the SL/TP of existing positions. For money management, there is no dynamic position sizing based on account balance or risk ratio. In Stealth Mode, SL/TP information is stored in chart objects rather than sent to the server, preventing the broker from seeing these levels, but this requires the EA to run continuously for SL/TP execution to work.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, SL distance per order

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

parameters.name: BEActivation
parameters.description: 保本激活点数（浮盈达到此值时触发）
parameters.description_en: Break-even activation points (triggered at this floating profit)

parameters.name: BELevel
parameters.description: 保本止损距开仓价的点数
parameters.description_en: Break-even SL distance from open price in points

parameters.name: TSDistance
parameters.description: 移动止损距价格距离点数
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance from price in points

parameters.name: TSEndBE
parameters.description: 移动止损是否以保本水平为上限
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop capped at break-even level

parameters.name: StealthMode
parameters.description: 隐身模式，止损止盈不发送至服务器
parameters.description_en: Stealth mode, SL/TP not sent to server

parameters.name: OnlyCurrentPairInit
parameters.description: 仅管理当前交易对的持仓
parameters.description_en: Manage positions for current symbol only

pros: 功能全面，集止损止盈、保本、移动止损于一体，一个EA覆盖多种仓位管理需求
隐身模式设计巧妙，通过图表对象存储止损止盈水平，避免经纪商看到交易意图
兼顾持仓和挂单管理，对pending orders也进行止损止盈设置，管理范围完整
考虑了品种的小数位数差异（3/5位小数），自动调整point值，适配性较好
尊重止损止位的经纪商限制（SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL），避免无效修改请求
pros_en: Comprehensive functionality integrating SL/TP, Break Even, and Trailing Stop management in a single EA
Clever Stealth Mode design that stores SL/TP levels as chart objects, hiding trading intentions from the broker
Manages both open positions and pending orders, providing complete coverage of trade management
Handles symbol digit differences (3/5 decimal places) by auto-adjusting point values for better compatibility
Respects broker stop level restrictions (SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL), preventing invalid modification requests
cons: 隐身模式下EA必须持续运行，若EA意外停止则止损止盈不会执行，存在极大风险
代码重复严重，买单和卖单的止损止盈管理逻辑几乎完全复制粘贴，违反DRY原则
缺乏对PositionModify和OrderModify失败的完善处理，仅打印错误日志而不做重试
OnTick中每次tick都遍历所有持仓，在高频行情下可能造成不必要的性能开销
订单循环中使用(ticket-1)>0的判断逻辑有误，ticket为0时-1溢出为ulong最大值仍大于0
缺乏新bar检测机制，同一bar内可能重复执行止损止盈修改
cons_en: In Stealth Mode, the EA must run continuously—if it stops unexpectedly, SL/TP will not execute, creating significant risk
Severe code duplication with buy and sell SL/TP management logic nearly copy-pasted, violating DRY principle
Incomplete error handling for PositionModify and OrderModify failures—only logs errors without retry logic
OnTick iterates all positions on every tick, potentially causing unnecessary performance overhead during high-frequency quotes
Order loop uses (ticket-1)>0 check which is flawed—when ticket is 0, subtracting 1 from ulong overflows to max value and still passes
No new bar detection mechanism, potentially causing redundant SL/TP modifications within the same bar
improvements: 将买单和卖单的止损止盈、保本、移动止损逻辑提取为通用函数，消除大量重复代码
添加新bar检测机制，避免同一bar内重复执行修改操作，提升性能和逻辑正确性
修复订单循环中的(ticket-1)>0判断为ticket>0，避免ulong溢出导致的逻辑错误
为PositionModify/OrderModify添加重试机制和更完善的错误处理
隐身模式下添加心跳检测和警告机制，当EA检测到可能中断时提醒用户
improvements_en: Extract buy and sell SL/TP, Break Even, and Trailing Stop logic into common functions to eliminate extensive code duplication
Add new bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant modification operations within the same bar, improving performance and correctness
Fix the (ticket-1)>0 check in the order loop to ticket>0, preventing ulong overflow logic errors
Add retry mechanism and more robust error handling for PositionModify/OrderModify calls
Add heartbeat detection and warning mechanism in Stealth Mode to alert users when the EA may be interrupted

risk_points: 隐身模式下EA停止运行则止损止盈完全失效，持仓将处于无保护状态
订单循环中ulong溢出bug可能导致对无效ticket执行操作
缺乏新bar检测，频繁修改止损可能在剧烈行情时被拒绝或产生滑点
risk_points_en: In Stealth Mode, if the EA stops running, SL/TP becomes completely ineffective, leaving positions unprotected
The ulong overflow bug in the order loop could cause operations on invalid tickets
Lack of new bar detection may cause frequent SL modifications to be rejected or produce slippage during volatile markets

It automatically applies Stop Loss, Take Profit, Break Even, and Trailing Stop management to existing positions and pending orders, with an optional Stealth Mode that hides SL/TP levels from the broker using chart objects instead of server-side orders.
